title: The Home page, next version — round 1, the lights card, fourth look

steps.path: Pages → Home, Destin's Room, lights card open
steps.headline: The lights card is one surface now: no line under the All row, and its bulb lines up with the bulbs below.
steps.changed: The All row had its own tint that stopped in a hard edge above the lights. Now the whole card shares one soft tint in the colour of a light that is on, the line is gone, and the All row's bulb sits in line with each light's bulb.
steps.notice: Each light is still its own card inside, the same gap on every side.
steps.risk: With every light off, the card has no tint at all, just the plain card colour.
